facts.text: Samuel Merritt College was one of the first hospital-based nursing schools in the nation to successfully transition to an accredited four-year degree-granting institution.

sources.title: Our History - Samuel Merritt University
sources.quote: Samuel Merritt College became one of the nation's first hospital-based nursing schools to successfully transition to an accredited four-year degree-granting institution.

facts.text: In 1999, Samuel Merritt established the first master's degree program for physician assistants in the western United States.
